scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:ml"
scripts.prod:install: npm run install:all && cd ml-service && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm
scripts.prod:start: NODE_ENV=production concurrently "cd backend && npm start" "cd ml-service && python app.py"
scripts.prod:start:win: set NODE_ENV=production && concurrently "cd backend && npm start" "cd ml-service && python app.py"
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend
